LESSON: LAUNDRY: LOOSE- COLOURED ITEMS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Hygiene Practises
Topic 3.2: Laundry: Loose- coloured Items
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Laundry: Loose- coloured Items, part of Hygiene Practises in Grade 7 AGRICULTURE.

Key inquiry question: How do you launder a loose- coloured article for hygienic purposes?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
